sentences.text: ClaimCheck verifies study notes against their source.
Paste a passage and your bullets.
No network, no model, no keys.
Each bullet splits into atoms: figures, years, names, causal verbs.
Seven atoms here, five on a passage span.
The headline is rule coverage, not truth.
One figure drifted: twelve gates in the notes, nine in the passage.
The table prints the exact span and a one line fix, and the moved date is contradicted too.
The heat sample catches a subtler error.
The draft says tree cover causes cooler summers, but the passage only reports association.
The trial notes say the treatment shortens recovery; the passage hedges that it may.
A spelled out number is unverifiable, not guessed.
Open the second reader and paste a revision: three verdicts flip, one support lost and two gained.
ClaimCheck stays narrow: rules not semantics, the passage as the only source, and silence never treated as disproof.
